summary: Fixed version mismatch by replacing hardcoded __version__ with dynamic importlib.metadata.version() call
approach: Use importlib.metadata.version('flywheel') to read version from pyproject.toml at runtime
risks: PackageVersionNotFoundError will be raised if package is not installed (expected behavior)
acceptance_criteria_met: flywheel.__version__ returns same value as pyproject.toml version
Changing pyproject.toml version automatically reflects in flywheel.__version__
No hardcoded version string in src/flywheel/__init__.py
